/.title: Studio Tools — Free Online Image, OCR & PDF Tools
/.heading: Free online image, OCR and PDF tools
/.description: Remove backgrounds, upscale photos with AI, extract English and Nepali text with OCR, and edit, sign, merge and convert PDFs. Free, private, no install.

/image-tools.title: Free Image Tools Online — AI Background Remover & More | Studio Tools
/image-tools.heading: Image tools
/image-tools.description: Every image tool in one place: remove backgrounds, upscale with AI, retouch, crop, resize, compress and make passport photos. Free and private.

/documents.title: Free PDF & Document Tools Online | Studio Tools
/documents.heading: PDF and document tools
/documents.description: Every PDF and text tool in one place: merge, split, compress, edit, sign, protect and convert PDFs, plus OCR and a rich text editor. Free and private.

/remove-background.title: Remove Background from Image Free — AI Cutout | Studio Tools
/remove-background.heading: Remove the background from an image
/remove-background.description: Remove image backgrounds in seconds with AI. Get a transparent PNG or a new background colour, refine edges, and download in full quality. Free and private.

/upscale.title: AI Image Upscaler — Enlarge Photos 2× or 4× | Studio Tools
/upscale.heading: Upscale images with AI
/upscale.description: Enlarge photos 2× or 4× with AI and keep them sharp. Restore detail in small, low-resolution images and download high-quality results for free.

/retouch.title: AI Photo Retouch — Remove Objects & Blemishes | Studio Tools
/retouch.heading: Retouch photos with AI
/retouch.description: Paint over objects, blemishes or distractions and let AI remove them cleanly. Smooth skin, sharpen detail and relight photos in your browser for free.

/photo-generator.title: Passport & MRP Photo Maker — Print-Ready | Studio Tools
/photo-generator.heading: Make passport and MRP photos
/photo-generator.description: Create passport and MRP photos at the right size with a white background, face checks and a print-ready sheet. Free, fast and private.

/watermark-remover.title: Watermark Remover for Images You Own | Studio Tools
/watermark-remover.heading: Remove watermarks from images
/watermark-remover.description: Remove text, logos and marks from images you own. Brush over the watermark and AI fills the area naturally. Free online watermark remover.

/compress.title: Image Compressor — Reduce JPG, PNG & WebP Size | Studio Tools
/compress.heading: Compress images
/compress.description: Make JPG, PNG and WebP images smaller without losing visible quality. Compress in batches, set a target file size and compare before and after. Free.

/crop.title: Crop Image Online — Any Aspect Ratio | Studio Tools
/crop.heading: Crop, rotate and straighten images
/crop.description: Crop photos to any aspect ratio — 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 and more — then rotate, flip and straighten. A fast, free online image cropper.

/editor.title: Free Online Photo Editor — Adjust, Filters, Resize | Studio Tools
/editor.heading: Edit photos online
/editor.description: Adjust brightness, contrast and colour, apply filters, crop and resize photos, then export as JPG, PNG or WebP. A free photo editor in your browser.

/ocr.title: OCR — Image & PDF to Editable Text, Nepali + English | Studio Tools
/ocr.heading: Turn images and PDFs into editable text
/ocr.description: Extract English and Nepali text from images and scanned PDFs with OCR. Keep headings, lists and tables, edit the result and export to Word, PDF or TXT.

/text/editor.title: Online Text Editor — Clean, Case Convert & Word Count | Studio Tools
/text/editor.heading: Write, clean and format text
/text/editor.description: A free rich text editor with a text cleaner, case converter (UPPER, lower, Title) and word counter built in. Export to Word, PDF, HTML or TXT.

/text/cleaner.title: Text Cleaner — Remove Extra Spaces & Line Breaks | Studio Tools
/text/cleaner.heading: Clean up text
/text/cleaner.description: Remove extra spaces, duplicate lines and broken line breaks, and fix OCR mistakes. Preview every change before applying it. Free online text cleaner.

/text/case-converter.title: Case Converter — UPPER, lower, Title & Sentence Case | Studio Tools
/text/case-converter.heading: Convert text case
/text/case-converter.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case or Sentence case while keeping its formatting. A free online case converter.

/text/word-counter.title: Word Counter — Words, Characters & Reading Time | Studio Tools
/text/word-counter.heading: Count words and characters
/text/word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time as you type, in English and Nepali. A free online word counter.

/pdf/merge.title: Merge PDF — Combine PDF Files Free | Studio Tools
/pdf/merge.heading: Merge PDF files
/pdf/merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one document. Drag to set the order, rotate files and merge in seconds. Free, private and no sign-up.

/pdf/split.title: Split PDF — Extract Pages or Ranges Free | Studio Tools
/pdf/split.heading: Split a PDF
/pdf/split.description: Split a PDF into single pages or custom page ranges and download them as separate files. A free, fast and private online PDF splitter.

/pdf/organize.title: Organize PDF Pages — Reorder, Delete & Duplicate | Studio Tools
/pdf/organize.heading: Organize PDF pages
/pdf/organize.description: Reorder, delete, duplicate, rotate and extract PDF pages with drag and drop and undo. Free online PDF page organizer.

/pdf/rotate.title: Rotate PDF — Turn Pages the Right Way Up | Studio Tools
/pdf/rotate.heading: Rotate PDF pages
/pdf/rotate.description: Rotate all or selected PDF pages by 90° or 180° and save the result permanently. A free online tool to rotate PDF pages.

/pdf/compress.title: Compress PDF — Reduce PDF File Size Free | Studio Tools
/pdf/compress.heading: Compress a PDF
/pdf/compress.description: Reduce PDF file size while keeping text sharp and photos clear. Choose a compression level and see exactly how much smaller it gets. Free.

/pdf/viewer.title: PDF Viewer Online — Read, Search & Print | Studio Tools
/pdf/viewer.heading: View PDF files
/pdf/viewer.description: Open and read PDFs in your browser: thumbnails, zoom, text search, page jump, rotate, print and download. Nothing is uploaded.

/pdf/to-images.title: PDF to JPG, PNG & WebP — Convert Pages | Studio Tools
/pdf/to-images.heading: Convert PDF to images
/pdf/to-images.description: Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG, PNG or WebP images. Choose the pages, resolution and quality, then download as a ZIP. Free.

/pdf/images-to-pdf.title: Images to PDF — JPG & PNG to PDF Free | Studio Tools
/pdf/images-to-pdf.heading: Convert images to PDF
/pdf/images-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC images into one PDF. Set the page size, orientation, margins and order. A free online image to PDF converter.

/pdf/to-word.title: PDF to Word — Convert PDF to Editable DOCX | Studio Tools
/pdf/to-word.heading: Convert PDF to Word
/pdf/to-word.description: Convert PDFs to editable Word documents, keeping headings, lists, tables and images. OCR for scanned pages, in English and Nepali. Free.

/pdf/to-text.title: PDF to Text — Extract Text from PDF, OCR for Scans | Studio Tools
/pdf/to-text.heading: Extract text from a PDF
/pdf/to-text.description: Extract text from digital PDFs instantly and read scanned PDFs with OCR, in English and Nepali. Edit, copy or export as TXT, Word or PDF.

/pdf/editor.title: Edit PDF Online — Add Text, Images & Shapes | Studio Tools
/pdf/editor.heading: Edit a PDF
/pdf/editor.description: Add text, images, drawings, highlights, shapes and arrows to a PDF, or delete pages. Undo, redo and save. A free online PDF editor.

/pdf/sign.title: Sign PDF Online — Draw, Type or Upload a Signature | Studio Tools
/pdf/sign.heading: Sign a PDF
/pdf/sign.description: Add your signature to a PDF: draw it, type it or upload a photo. Place, resize and date it, then download. Free online PDF signing.

/pdf/watermark.title: Add Watermark to PDF — Text or Logo | Studio Tools
/pdf/watermark.heading: Add a watermark to a PDF
/pdf/watermark.description: Stamp text or a logo on every PDF page or selected pages. Set the position, angle, size and opacity. A free online PDF watermark tool.

/pdf/page-numbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF — Free & Easy | Studio Tools
/pdf/page-numbers.heading: Add page numbers to a PDF
/pdf/page-numbers.description: Number PDF pages in the format and position you want, such as "Page 1 of 10", starting from any number. Free online PDF page numbering.

/pdf/protect.title: Protect PDF — Add a Password (AES-256) | Studio Tools
/pdf/protect.heading: Password-protect a PDF
/pdf/protect.description: Lock a PDF with a password using AES-256 encryption and choose whether people can print, copy or edit it. Free online PDF protection.

/pdf/unlock.title: Unlock PDF — Remove a PDF Password | Studio Tools
/pdf/unlock.heading: Remove a PDF password
/pdf/unlock.description: Remove the password from a PDF you're allowed to open, or lift its printing and copying restrictions. Free online PDF unlocker.
